notes: Method: gov.il, btl.gov.il, boi.org.il and my.gov.il were read in the built-in browser (curl and WebFetch get HTTP 403 from gov.il's bot wall); data.gov.il and openapi-portal.taxes.gov.il were read with plain HTTP. Accordion text was read from the page DOM. Source dates are the 'עודכן לאחרונה בתאריך' / 'תאריך עדכון' lines printed on the page; null where the page prints none. 'cost' is 'free' only where the page says so; 'login' values: national-id | certificate | password | none | null, with the real options in login_note. 'api.available' is true only where developer-facing documentation or a live API was seen. Categories used (the manifest's category map for this topic is empty): tax, customs-trade, social-insurance, corporate-registry, open-data, licensing, identity, employment, intellectual-property, privacy, open-banking, non-profits, small-business-support, postal. Not covered because no page was opened: Population Authority, public procurement, pension clearing house, Bituach Leumi self-employed.
